evidence_policy.confirmed_hand_history: Exact action line reconstructed from a saved PokerStars hand history and converted to BB.
evidence_policy.confirmed_showdown: Hole cards were exposed in a saved history or clearly shown at the table.
evidence_policy.screen_observation: Observed on screen but not yet reconciled against a saved hand history.
evidence_policy.tentative_read: Small-sample inference that must not override strong hand-specific evidence.
